category_title: Eighteen-year-old autistic student acting as an online upstander despite literacy challenges
scenario_title: Pastoral conversation following an online upstander incident
minimal_context: The student and a staff member are having a one-on-one discussion at school about an online argument the student was involved in.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's discuss what happened online yesterday when you tried to argue with the other students.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He was picking on a little kid. It was the wrong thing to do, so I told him to take the video down.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What did they say to you?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He said it was nothing to do with me, but he was out of order. Then he started abusing me for my poor spelling.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I started trying to argue my corner! But then five other students joined in and started ganging up on me, ridiculing my spelling. It was five pupils against one girl and I couldn't defend myself!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's discuss what happened online yesterday when you tried to argue with the other students.

STUDENT: He was picking on a little kid. It was the wrong thing to do, so I told him to take the video down.

TUTOR: What did they say to you?

STUDENT: He said it was nothing to do with me, but he was out of order. Then he started abusing me for my poor spelling.

TUTOR: What did you do then?

STUDENT: I started trying to argue my corner! But then five other students joined in and started ganging up on me, ridiculing my spelling. It was five pupils against one girl and I couldn't defend myself!

task.content: Discussing how trying to argue on-line exposed her vulnerability
task.learning_goal: Interpreting appropriate social rules and empathising with others

context.materials: Real-life social stories, differentiated and undifferentiated worksheets
context.social_setting: One-on-one discussion with a member of staff

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Being ridiculed for her spelling and being attacked on-line by five children
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Started trying to argue her corner and instead of being one against one it was five pupils against one girl, tries to defend herself unsuccessfully
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Potential to have a severe impact due to history of self-harm and mental health problems

behavior_patterns.condition: When she accuses a peer of being unfair to a younger child
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Exhibits self-less 'upstander' behaviour by requesting that the peer take down the video, challenged the accepted code
